question: May F4 replace its unpublished-allocation rollback/capacity-restoration requirement with F1-compatible bounded terminal retention (retain all acquired frames, publish no USER PDE on prepublication failure, halt without retry)? This changes only the current F4 requirement; F1 remains unchanged.
user_response: Authorize bounded terminal retention; revise design and obtain fresh independent approval
effect: Supersedes only F4 unpublished-allocation rollback/capacity-restoration wording. Admitted failures retain all acquired resources and terminate, no retry. Pure preflight refusals remain nonmutating. No prepublication failure publishes the USER PDE. F1/F2/F3 contracts, resource ceilings and all other original F4 requirements remain unchanged.
